Package neqsim.util.serialization

Class NeqSimXtream

java.lang.Object
neqsim.util.serialization.NeqSimXtream
public class NeqSimXtream extends Object
NeqSimXtream class for serializing and deserializing NeqSim objects.

Provides compressed XML serialization using XStream with ZIP compression. The resulting .neqsim files are compact and portable.

Features:

  • Automatic ThreadLocal field exclusion
  • ZIP compression for compact storage, written atomically (a failed save never leaves a truncated file)
  • Full object graph preservation with ID references
  • A neqsim-meta.properties entry recording the NeqSim and Java versions that wrote the file
  • Cross-version loading: unknown classes and fields are skipped, renamed fields are mapped, and files written without the metadata entry (NeqSim versions before it was introduced) are loaded in legacy mode

XStream creates objects without running constructors, so a field added to a class after a file was written would otherwise keep its JVM default (null, 0 or false) instead of its declared initial value. In legacy mode every field that is absent from the stored XML is restored from a freshly constructed template instance of the same class, and classes that gained a private readObject hook can still be read from the plain field layout used by older versions; the hook is then run with a no-op ObjectInputStream so its post-load repairs apply. What was skipped, mapped and restored is available from getLastLoadReport().

    • saveNeqsim

      public static boolean saveNeqsim(Object javaobject, String filename)
      Saves an object to a compressed .neqsim file.

      The object is serialized to XML using XStream and compressed using ZIP compression. The file is first written to a temporary file in the same directory and moved into place only after serialization succeeded, so a failed save leaves any existing file untouched and never leaves a truncated file behind.

      Parameters:
      javaobject - the object to serialize (typically ProcessSystem or ProcessModel)
      filename - the path to save to (recommended extension: .neqsim)
      Returns:
      true if save was successful, false otherwise

    • createConfiguredXStream

      private static com.thoughtworks.xstream.XStream createConfiguredXStream(NeqSimXtream.LoadReport report)
      Creates a configured XStream instance with sensible defaults for NeqSim serialization.

      Uses the default reflection provider (sun.misc.Unsafe when available) to avoid ExceptionInInitializerError that occurs with PureJavaReflectionProvider on JDK 11+. Includes mapper wrappers to skip ThreadLocal fields and to tolerate classes, fields and renamed fields from other versions, plus a converter for NeqSim classes that reads both the current and the legacy field layout.

      Parameters:
      report - load report to fill, or null when the instance is used for saving
      Returns:
      a configured XStream instance
